WITH grouped_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    o.ordertune,
    COUNT(*) AS exec_count
  FROM orderexecutions oe
  INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(exec_count) AS total FROM grouped_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    gc.ordertune,
    gc.exec_count,
    CAST(gc.exec_count AS FLOAT) / tc.total AS share
  FROM grouped_counts gc
  CROSS JOIN total_count tc
),
avg_share_cte AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS overall_avg FROM with_shares
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    ws.exec_count,
    ws.share,
    a.overall_avg
  FROM with_shares ws
  CROSS JOIN avg_share_cte a
  WHERE ws.share > a.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  SUM(exec_count) AS sum_counts,
  AVG(share) AS avg_share,
  AVG(share - overall_avg) AS avg_excess
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: "A missing order type forms its own group" refers to NULL values for ordertune being treated as a distinct group, not to executions without matching orders (which are excluded by the INNER JOIN as required).
